claim_summary: For every finite simple graph \(G\) on \(n\ge1\) vertices, \(\mathcal M(W(G))\) is contractible if \(G\) has no perfect matching and is \(\bigvee^{p(G)}S^{n/2-1}\) otherwise.
integrity: Explicit reduced acyclic matching proved for every face; the finite executable verifier is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. The same mathematical claim is used consistently throughout the package.
limitations: Finite simple nonempty base graphs only; ordinary matching complex, not perfect-matching complex; no equivariant classification, weighted filtration, or independent external audit.
title: Perfect matchings control the homotopy type of every fully whiskered matching complex
